description: THE MARKS, NOT THE PIXELS. Returns every mark on the named shot — kind, position, colour, caption — plus its crop rectangle and its true size. This is how you find out what a PERSON drew: they marked the broken total with an arrow and typed a word beside it, and that word is readable here rather than being an image somebody has to look at. It deliberately does NOT return the picture: a full-page shot is megabytes of base64 through a channel that copies every byte, and the question was what is on it. Use qa_screenshot when pixels are what you need.
